content:
Apple has launched the iOS 27.2 beta, and this update brings a number of notable changes and new features. Here's everything you need to know about iOS 27.2, which is expected to roll out to iPhone users as early as next month.

Why iOS 27.2 instead of iOS 27.1?

Apple launched iOS 27 on September 14, bringing a host of new iPhone features including Siri AI. iOS 27.2 entered beta testing just two days later on September 16.

What happened to iOS 27.1?

Apple has previously confirmed that the iPhone Duo will ship with iOS 27.1 pre-installed when it launches on October 23. In other words, iOS 27.1 contains a lot of code related to the iPhone Duo, and Apple wants to keep it under wraps until the device officially goes on sale. So iOS 27.1 will be exclusive to the iPhone Duo.

After that, the software roadmap for the iPhone Duo and other iPhone models will converge, possibly through an iOS 27.2.x update or iOS 27.3.

So there will be an awkward period for a while, but eventually things will return to normal.

iOS 27.2 new features

Redesigned Health app

At the iPhone 18 Pro launch event, Apple showed off a brand-new version of the Health app and said it would arrive later this year. This new app has made its debut in the iOS 27.2 beta.

The redesigned Health app is divided into three tabs: Insights, Longevity, and Browse. The app features a completely new design that dynamically adapts based on your data, including Apple Intelligence features. The Longevity tab adds a new Health age feature that uses Apple Watch data to show how your body metrics compare to your actual age.

The new Health app is unlikely to launch alongside iOS 27.2 next month. Instead, Apple will roll out the beta first before officially releasing it to all users later this year.

Further reading: iOS 27.2 brings a major overhaul to the Apple Health app — here's a look at the new features

Profiles feature added to the TV app

The Apple TV app in iOS 27.2 gains support for profiles for the first time. This feature has actually been available on tvOS for years, but this is the first time it has come to iPhone.

Further reading: iOS 27.2 brings new profile features to Apple TV on iPhone

More Siri AI languages

Siri AI is a key new feature of iOS 27, and iOS 27.2 extends this feature to more users. This update adds Siri AI support for the following languages:

  • French
  • Japanese
  • Korean
  • Portuguese
  • Spanish

Group FaceTime dual-camera mode

In iOS 27, Apple added a dual-camera feature to FaceTime, allowing you to use both the front and rear cameras at the same time. The person on the other end of the call can see both you and what you're looking at. iOS 27.2 extends this feature to group FaceTime calls for the first time.

The dual-camera feature requires an iPhone 17 or later, and everyone on the call must be running iOS 27.

Further reading: iOS 27.2 takes FaceTime's best new feature to the next level

Other small details

  • In Apple Podcasts, the "Up Next" playlist has been renamed to "Latest Episodes." The "Continue Playing" section sits directly beneath "Latest Episodes." Episode lists also feature color-coordinated backgrounds based on the podcast's cover art.
  • In the Music app, some red icons and accents have been changed to black.
  • iOS 27's Business Caller ID feature (which displays relevant information directly on the screen when calling a business) has been expanded to support anniversary information.
  • The Clock app's alarm interface has minor tweaks, such as smaller fonts for the AM and PM labels.

Features hinted at for the future

Finally, code in iOS 27.2 hints at several new features that may soon be coming to iPhone users, including real-time countdown timers for new Apple Music album releases, third-party app support for "Describe a Shortcut," and new CarPlay Ultra themes. iOS 27.2 also shows Apple continuing to develop iPhone anti-theft features.

These features are not yet enabled in iOS 27.2, but the code shows Apple is actively developing them internally.

iOS 27.2 release date

iOS 27.2 is expected to roll out to iPhone users at some point in October. Apple has promised that Siri AI will gain new languages in October, and since iOS 27.2 adds these new languages, Apple must release this update before November to deliver on that promise.

Wrapping up

Are you running the iOS 27.2 beta? Have you found any useful new features? What do you think of the new Health app? Feel free to share with us in the comments section.
